The 'texture_anomaly' (Severity 2.5) is also valid; the metal looks waxy/painted rather than machined. The Image Text Auditor confirmed the text is unreadable (empty blocks), supporting the gibberish verdict. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask is misleading here—it simply segmented the blob, not verifying its mechanical validity.
